scenario.name: Inconclusive verification and rollback (seed 3)
scenario.tagline: The intervention is not proven, so the previous policy is restored
scenario.description: The 'mixed' generator workload at seed 3 under the same waiting-time rule. Degradation is detected and SJF is selected, but the residual stays inside the declared null range, so the verdict is inconclusive and the controller rolls back to FCFS. Inconclusive is not the same as rejected.
scenario.expectation: Verification closes inconclusive; the trace rolls back to FCFS with no confirmed failure.

healing.summary: Verification closed inconclusive (inconclusive_residual_within_null_range): the residual +0.2059 stayed inside the null range between -0.30 and +0.30. The change is neither proven nor rejected, so the controller rolled back to FCFS.

stages.title: Normal scheduling
stages.detail: FCFS dispatches the trace until the incident at t=141: 6 recorded intervals before it.

stages.title: Monitoring
stages.detail: Rolling statistic over 6 completed processes: mean 51.00, median 42.00, maximum 128.00; stable reference 23.75 with dispersion band 3.56.

stages.title: Degradation detected
stages.detail: The window mean 51.00 exceeded the threshold 28.20 = reference 23.75 + 3.56-unit band x the declared multiplier, for 2 consecutive evaluations. Detector reason: degradation_detected.

stages.title: Diagnosis
stages.detail: fairness_starvation: oldest ready job has waited at least 132 time units (recent completed-work wait 51.0 vs reference 23.8 (band 3.6, window 6 completions); also matched: priority_ordering_anomaly, fairness_starvation, queue_congestion) Matched categories: priority_ordering_anomaly,fairness_starvation,queue_congestion. Visible remaining work at the trigger: 172 units.

stages.title: Selected intervention
stages.detail: Offered actions: hold,set_sjf,set_round_robin,set_priority. Chosen: set_sjf (predeclared_waiting_time_rule: declared action for diagnosis fairness_starvation). Action note: policy changed. Configuration: FCFS q=4 -> SJF q=4.

stages.title: Observation window
stages.detail: The window closed after 5 decisions and 5 completions.

stages.title: Verification
stages.detail: Verdict inconclusive; reason inconclusive_residual_within_null_range. Closure fraction 1.224 against the expected no-action closure 1.018; residual +0.2059. Declared boundaries: accept at or above +0.30, reject at or below -0.30, otherwise inconclusive.

stages.title: Final decision
stages.detail: rolled back to FCFS. Confirmed failure: False. Consecutive confirmed failures: 0. Safe fallback triggered: False. Post-window dispatches: 4; final policy FCFS. Reward -0.1607; charged cost 0.0667 band units.

incident.request_note: predeclared_waiting_time_rule: declared action for diagnosis fairness_starvation
